integrity: All claims are based on the included self-contained proof and exact calculation. No external independent audit or expert certification has been performed.
scientific_limitations: The theorem is for immediate primitive-three states on open two-row ladders only. The 1980 Greenberg–Greene–Hastings full text was unavailable; potential exact enumeration under alternate cyclic-neighbor terminology remains a priority risk. A general algebraic proof and executable exact finite checks are supplied.
title: Exact primitive-three wave census on open ladders
